questions.q_en:
In this question, a statement is followed by two conclusions, numbered I and II. Decide which of the two conclusions is/are true based on the given statement.

Statement: M < N ≤ O = S > T ≥ W ≥ Z

Conclusions:

I. M ≤ T

II. N < Z
options_en: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II are true
Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II is true
questions.solution_en:
We have the inequality series as:-

M < N ≤ O = S > T ≥ W ≥ Z

So:-

I. M ≤ T :- It is false because, M < N ≤ O = S > T

II. N < Z :- It is false because N ≤ O = S > T ≥ W ≥ Z

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

Chickenpox : Virus
questions.solution_en:
The word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to "Chickenpox : Virus" is "Anthrax : Bacteria".

Hence, option (d) is correct.
